title: Source Surface Registry

blackbox.does: Serves the canonical catalog of registered source surfaces with their endpoints, license terms, rate limits, and usage policies. Answers lookup queries and records surface registrations, updates, and deprecations.

known_failure_modes: stale endpoint URL served after an upstream portal migration
same surface registered twice under different ids
license terms field left blank for a newly added surface
policy record out of sync with an upstream terms-of-service change

title: CKAN Package and Resource Harvester

blackbox.does: Enumerates CKAN packages and resources matching a harvest policy, downloads selected resources, and records a snapshot receipt with checksums, timestamps, and license metadata for each fetched resource.

known_failure_modes: package_search pagination silently truncates beyond the row limit
resource URL returns an HTML error page instead of the data file
portal rate limiting causes a partial harvest without an error
resource format field mislabels the actual file type
dataset license field missing or set to notspecified

title: Socrata SoQL Dataset Ingester

blackbox.does: Executes SoQL queries against a Socrata dataset with paging and app-token headers, returning typed records plus a snapshot receipt covering query text, row counts, and dataset metadata.

known_failure_modes: missing app token triggers aggressive throttling
offset paging skips or repeats rows when the dataset updates mid-harvest
SoQL type coercion drops leading zeros from FIPS codes
field renamed upstream breaks the extraction schema
point columns returned in inconsistent latitude-longitude order

title: ArcGIS FeatureServer Layer Ingester

blackbox.does: Pages through an ArcGIS FeatureServer or MapServer layer with resultOffset queries, reprojects geometries to the requested CRS, and emits features with a snapshot receipt covering layer metadata and record-count handling.

known_failure_modes: maxRecordCount cap silently truncates result pages
layer served in Web Mercator while the receipt assumes WGS84
exceededTransferLimit flag ignored leading to missing features
geometry quantization degrades coordinate precision
server returns HTTP 200 with an embedded JSON error object

title: HRSA Health Center Site Ingester

blackbox.does: Pulls HRSA health center site records for an area of interest from the published site-level datasets and the find-a-health-center surface, returning directory-level site records with a snapshot receipt. Emits facility directory fields only, never patient-level data.

known_failure_modes: administrative parent organization conflated with a service delivery site
site marked temporarily closed still listed as active
service area columns change position between quarterly releases
duplicate sites appear under renamed grantee organizations

title: NPPES Provider Identity Resolver

blackbox.does: Resolves candidate provider and facility records against the NPPES NPI registry using name, address, and taxonomy match rules, recording per-candidate match decisions with scores and rule traces. Operates on public directory identities only.

known_failure_modes: organizational NPI matched to an individual clinician of the same name
practice location differs from mailing address causing false negatives
deactivated NPI reused from stale candidate data
taxonomy code granularity mismatch inflates false positives
monthly file lag hides recent enumeration changes

title: CareerOneStop Training Provider Adapter

blackbox.does: Queries the CareerOneStop training provider API and state ETPL directory exports for providers and programs within an area of interest, returning provider records with a snapshot receipt covering query parameters and result coverage.

known_failure_modes: API key quota exhaustion mid-harvest returns partial coverage
state ETPL export formats differ per state and break parsing
program CIP codes missing for a large share of providers
provider listed at headquarters address rather than campus location

title: College Scorecard and IPEDS Program Adapter

blackbox.does: Fetches institution and program records from the College Scorecard API and IPEDS survey files filtered by geography and program criteria, and joins them into institution-program records with a snapshot receipt.

known_failure_modes: branch campus records collapsed under the main campus UNITID
field-of-study rows suppressed for privacy leaving nulls
Scorecard data year lags the IPEDS release causing join mismatches
paging cursor expires on large state-level pulls

title: OSM Overpass Bounded POI Query

blackbox.does: Builds and executes a bounded Overpass QL query for the requested OSM tag combinations, enforcing endpoint usage limits, and returns POI elements with an ODbL attribution receipt.

known_failure_modes: query timeout on large bounding boxes returns a truncated element set
ways and relations returned without resolved center coordinates
tag spelling variants missed by exact-match tag filters
public endpoint returns 429 under concurrent use
area filter fails when a boundary relation is incomplete

title: Overture and OpenAddresses Place Ingester

blackbox.does: Reads Overture Maps places and OpenAddresses collections for an area of interest from cloud-hosted release files, filters by category, and returns place records with per-source attribution and license receipts.

known_failure_modes: release version pinning drifts between reruns
category taxonomy changes across Overture releases
confidence scores absent for a large share of places
bounding box pushdown not applied causing full-release scans
OpenAddresses region file missing its license attachment

title: Dataset Schema Fingerprint

blackbox.does: Computes a stable fingerprint of a dataset sample covering field names, inferred types, null rates, and key-candidate columns, and emits a field profile report used to detect upstream schema drift.

known_failure_modes: sample too small to observe rare type variants
column order treated as significant causing spurious drift alerts
mixed-type columns fingerprinted differently across runs
unicode normalization differences change field name hashes

title: Entity Normalize and Dedupe

blackbox.does: Normalizes facility and provider records from multiple sources into a shared schema, then clusters and merges duplicates under the dedupe policy, recording every merge and survivorship decision in a receipt.

known_failure_modes: distinct co-located clinics merged into one entity
chain locations with identical names split inconsistently
survivorship rule picks the stalest phone number
normalization strips suite numbers that distinguish sites
transitive merges chain unrelated records together

title: Geocode Policy Gate

blackbox.does: Checks a geocode request batch against per-geocoder usage policies including rate limits, bulk-use restrictions, caching rules, and attribution duties, and emits an approved plan routing requests to compliant geocoders or rejecting them with reasons.

known_failure_modes: public Nominatim bulk restrictions not applied to large batches
policy cache serves an outdated rate limit after an upstream policy change
fallback geocoder selected without the required attribution duty attached
batch splitting approves total volume above the daily cap

title: Point to Boundary Spatial Join

blackbox.does: Assigns each point record to containing administrative or statistical boundaries using a point-in-polygon join, honoring the join policy for edge cases, and stamps the output with the boundary vintage used.

known_failure_modes: CRS mismatch places all points outside every polygon
points on shared boundaries assigned nondeterministically
coastal points fall outside generalized boundary polygons
boundary vintage differs from the ACS vintage used downstream
invalid polygon geometries silently dropped from the join

title: Nearest Facility Isochrone and Catchment Analysis

blackbox.does: Computes travel-time isochrones or nearest-facility catchments around facility points under a travel-time policy, overlays them on population geography, and reports covered and uncovered population with a method receipt describing routing engine, profile, and network vintage.

known_failure_modes: routing graph built from a stale OSM extract misses new roads
isochrone polygons self-intersect and break overlay area math
population apportioned by area instead of population weighting
facility points snapped to the wrong side of a divided highway
car profile applied where transit access was requested

title: Map Artifact Generation

blackbox.does: Renders spatial artifact sets into static maps or interactive dashboard pages under a style policy, embedding required attribution lines for every source layer, and emits the artifact with an attribution receipt.

known_failure_modes: layer renders blank when unprojected degree coordinates are treated as meters
attribution line omitted for a derived layer
color ramp hides zero-value areas entirely
large point layers freeze interactive output in the browser
legend labels detached from the actual class breaks

title: Evidence Bundle Wrapper

blackbox.does: Assembles the final evidence-backed answer by binding every claim to source spans and receipts, packaging source snapshots and spatial artifacts into a bundle, and attaching the uncertainty report. Refuses to emit claims that lack a bound source span.

known_failure_modes: claim bound to a span that no longer matches the snapshot text
bundle references an artifact file that was never written
uncertainty report omitted when all receipts are present
answer text edited after span binding invalidating offsets

title: Portal Change Monitor

blackbox.does: Polls watched portals and datasets on a schedule, compares metadata timestamps and schema fingerprints against stored baselines, and emits change events with freshness receipts when datasets move, change schema, or go stale.

known_failure_modes: portal reports an updated timestamp without an actual data change
dataset relocated to a new id leaving the old id serving stale rows
monitor floods change events during bulk portal migrations
baseline fingerprint lost after storage compaction
polling schedule violates a portal request budget

title: US Address Normalizer

blackbox.does: Parses and normalizes US addresses into structured components with USPS-style standardization rules, and reports per-address parse confidence without altering unparseable inputs.

known_failure_modes: unit designators merged into street names
rural route and highway contract addresses misparsed
directional prefixes swapped with street names in grid cities
ZIP plus-four dropped changing downstream dedupe keys

title: Registered Apprenticeship Program Adapter

blackbox.does: Fetches registered apprenticeship program and sponsor records from RAPIDS-derived public datasets filtered by geography and occupation, returning program records with a snapshot receipt.

known_failure_modes: sponsor address used in place of the training site address
occupation codes given in RAPIDS codes without an O*NET crosswalk
inactive programs retained without a status field in some extracts
multi-state sponsors duplicated per state file

title: Boundary Vintage Resolver

blackbox.does: Selects and fetches the correct boundary layer vintage for a request under the vintage policy, reconciling year, generalization level, and geography type, and stamps the layer with a vintage receipt.

known_failure_modes: post-2020 tract renumbering breaks joins against 2010-coded data
generalized cartographic boundary used where full TIGER geometry was required
Connecticut planning region change conflates county definitions across vintages
requested vintage unavailable and a fallback applied silently

title: Catchment Population Estimator

blackbox.does: Estimates population inside each catchment polygon by apportioning census unit populations under the apportionment policy, propagating margins of error and recording the method in a receipt.

known_failure_modes: areal apportionment assumes uniform density across block groups
overlapping catchments double count shared population
water area included in apportionment denominators
margins of error dropped when summing across units

title: Census ACS Population Join

blackbox.does: Fetches ACS estimates for the requested variables and geographies from the Census API and joins them onto boundary-tagged records, carrying margins of error through to the output with a snapshot receipt.

known_failure_modes: ACS vintage mismatched with the TIGER boundary vintage
margins of error dropped during the join
annotation sentinel values treated as real estimates
block group variables requested from a table only published at tract level

title: Coverage Gap Ranker

blackbox.does: Ranks uncovered or undercovered areas from a population coverage report according to a gap ranking policy over population weight, travel burden, and equity factors, producing an ordered gap area set for planning review. Produces planning inputs only, not siting decisions.

known_failure_modes: ranking dominated by one unnormalized factor
areas with suppressed population data silently ranked last
ties broken by unstable input order across runs
unchecked policy weights allow double counting of factors

title: CRS Transform Gate

blackbox.does: Validates and, where the policy allows, reprojects spatial layers to the required coordinate reference systems before analysis steps, rejecting layers with missing or contradictory CRS declarations.

known_failure_modes: layer with no CRS assumed WGS84 when it is a state plane projection
axis order confusion between EPSG 4326 conventions
datum shift skipped between NAD27 and NAD83 layers
area computed in degrees passes through unflagged

title: Facility Hours and Services Extractor

blackbox.does: Extracts opening hours and offered service categories from facility record free-text and tag fields into the extraction schema, binding every extracted value to its source span. Emits directory-level fields only and never infers clinical advice.

known_failure_modes: opening_hours syntax variants parsed inconsistently
seasonal or holiday hours flattened into weekly hours
service list invented from the facility name alone
span offsets break when source text is re-encoded

title: Gazetteer Place Name Resolver

blackbox.does: Resolves free-text place names to gazetteer entries with coordinates and administrative context, applying the resolution policy for ambiguity, and records per-name match decisions and alternates.

known_failure_modes: common place names resolved to the wrong country default
historical names absent from the gazetteer snapshot
diacritic stripping merges distinct places
feature class preference picks a stream over the town of the same name

title: Global Health Facility Registry Adapter

blackbox.does: Pulls facility lists for non-US areas of interest from healthsites.io, WHO GHFD-aligned national master facility lists, and HDX facility datasets, harmonizing minimal fields and recording per-source snapshot receipts with license terms.

known_failure_modes: national master list vintage unknown for many countries
HDX dataset licenses vary per contributor and block reuse
facility type vocabularies differ across countries
coordinates given at settlement centroid rather than the facility

title: GTFS Feed Ingester

blackbox.does: Downloads and validates a GTFS static feed, extracts stops, routes, and service frequency summaries used for transit access analysis, and records a snapshot receipt with feed version and validity window.

known_failure_modes: feed validity dates expired but the feed is still served by the agency
calendar_dates exceptions ignored misstating service frequency
stop coordinates placed at street centerline far from the boarding location
agency publishes multiple overlapping feeds for one network

title: H3 Grid Aggregation

blackbox.does: Indexes point records to H3 cells at the requested resolution and computes per-cell aggregate statistics, emitting a cell stat layer with a method receipt noting resolution and edge effects.

known_failure_modes: resolution too coarse hides local gaps in dense areas
pentagon cells distort area-normalized rates
small-count cells leak values below the suppression threshold
aggregation mixes resolutions when inputs are pre-indexed

title: Nominatim Policy-Compliant Geocoder

blackbox.does: Executes an approved geocode plan against Nominatim endpoints at the mandated request rate with caching and a descriptive user agent, returning geocoded points with per-address confidence and attribution receipts. Requires an ApprovedGeocodePlan from the geocode policy gate.

known_failure_modes: ambiguous street names resolved to the wrong municipality
PO box addresses geocoded to post office locations
throughput collapse on large batches at one request per second
cache key ignores locale producing mixed-language results

title: Official vs Open Coverage Comparator

blackbox.does: Matches facilities between an official registry set and an open-map set within the comparison policy tolerances, and reports agreement, official-only, and open-only counts by area to characterize open data completeness.

known_failure_modes: name tokenization mismatch undercounts agreement
distance tolerance too wide matches adjacent unrelated facilities
closed facilities in the open set inflate open-only counts
category crosswalk missing entries drops facilities from comparison

title: OGC API Records Harvester

blackbox.does: Walks an OGC API Records catalog with paged record queries, collects dataset metadata records and their distribution links, and emits a manifest with a snapshot receipt.

known_failure_modes: next links missing on some pages breaking traversal
records lack bounding boxes preventing spatial filtering
distribution links point to authentication-walled downloads
server mixes Records and STAC conventions in one catalog

title: OSRM Travel Time Matrix

blackbox.does: Computes an origin-destination travel time matrix against an OSRM instance for the requested routing profile and returns the matrix with a method receipt recording engine version and network extract vintage.

known_failure_modes: table size limit rejects large matrices without chunking
unsnappable origins return null durations that propagate as zeros
profile compiled without turn restrictions understates times
extract vintage differs from the isochrone step network

title: Provider Directory Freshness Scorer

blackbox.does: Scores each facility record for staleness using last-verified dates, source release cadence, and cross-source disagreement signals, and reports records that need reverification under the freshness policy.

known_failure_modes: source update timestamp reflects file regeneration not a content change
records without any dated field default to fresh instead of unknown
cross-source disagreement counted as staleness for both sources
cadence assumptions wrong for annually refreshed datasets

title: Spatial Dedupe Within Radius

blackbox.does: Clusters entities within a policy-defined radius using spatial indexing and merges clusters whose names and categories agree, recording distance, evidence, and decision for every merge in a receipt.

known_failure_modes: fixed radius merges distinct clinics in a medical office tower
geocode scatter leaves true duplicates outside the radius
index cell boundary effects split clusters at tile edges
vertically stacked facilities indistinguishable without floor data

title: Training Desert Analyzer

blackbox.does: Identifies areas where population exceeds a travel-time threshold from any qualifying training provider for the requested program categories, and reports desert areas with population counts and a method receipt.

known_failure_modes: online-only programs counted as physically accessible sites
program category crosswalk misses relevant CIP codes
provider records geocoded to administrative offices not campuses
desert threshold applied uniformly across urban and rural areas

title: Uncertainty Report Composer

blackbox.does: Composes a structured uncertainty report from the receipts of upstream steps, covering source freshness, geocode confidence, match ambiguity, boundary vintage alignment, and coverage caveats required by the uncertainty policy.

known_failure_modes: missing upstream receipt reported as zero uncertainty
caveat text truncated when many sources contribute
confidence categories collapsed losing per-source detail
policy-required caveat classes silently skipped
